body: Ito na yung threshold where I stop calling it a pile of press releases. May buyer-side commitment, device-fab expansion, substrate scale-up, at commercial epitaxy—all in one 2026 sequence. Hindi ibig sabihin na sold out lahat ng future wafers; pero mas defensible na ngayon ang ‘capacity cycle’ kaysa ‘AI optics hype.’ Next checkpoint ko: utilization + qualification. Ribbon-cutting is a signal; repeat orders are the receipt.

claims.text: The cross-layer sequence is sufficient to treat 2026 as a real InP capacity-cycle signal, while utilization and qualification remain the higher-value confirmation tests.
claims.basis: Inference from the article's separately sourced demand, fab, substrate and epitaxy milestones.
